يستسهلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَسْهِلُوا (yastashilū) /jas.tas.hi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# يُسْتَسْهَلُوا (yustashalū) /jus.tas.ha.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
